text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More 200 experts from Mediterranean countries gather in Morocco to study water pollution.
- No tax increase planned in draft budget.
- U.N. secretary-general's personal representative for Western Sahara leaves Morocco after two days of talks with officials.
- Moroccan farmers exported 656 tonnes of citrus fruit up to April 13.
- French business delegation to visit Morocco on May 4 for talks with government ministers and local industrialists.
